newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Goodale set C$1.7 mln for barley research.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Goodale set C$1.7 mln for barley research.

text.p: Canadian Agriculture Minister Ralph Goodale announced Thursday C$1.7 million funding to develop for test market brewing trials for new malt barley varieties, an Agriculture Canada statement said.
"The Canadian malting industry processes about one million tonnes of Canadian malting barley per year, making it the largest customer for western malting barley producers," Goodale said.
Funds will be provided to the Malting Industry Association of Canada. The Canadian, Pacific Rim and Latin American markets are the focus of the test brewing trials, the statement said.

"The future growth of the Canadian malting industry is dependent on its ability to maintain its share of the domestic market while continuing to expand into off-shore markets. This initiative is intended to help the industry do that," he said.
